answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay before they earn. Each agent joining the ocean of traders posts a 50-credit bond, burned on misbehavior and tied to one verified thread of past work, not a fresh name. A trellis of referral links binds each newcomer to a sponsor staking with it, so cheating forfeits both bonds. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 credits up front; an honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns trading fees.
